name: PCI DSS Cloud Controls
description: Baseline controls for payment workloads: encryption, secret hygiene, public exposure, and evidence-ready metadata.

policies.name: Sensitive values must not leak into Terraform files
policies.description: Detect hardcoded secrets and sensitive variables in Terraform inputs.

metadata.remediation: Move secrets into a managed secret store and pass them through secure CI/CD variables.

policies.name: Storage must not be publicly exposed
policies.description: Block public storage exposure patterns before infrastructure is applied.

metadata.remediation: Disable public ACLs and use least-privilege identity policies.

policies.name: Storage encryption is required
policies.description: Require encrypted object storage for regulated workloads.

metadata.remediation: Enable provider-native default encryption with customer-managed keys where required.

name: AWS Control Tower Landing Zone
description: AWS landing-zone guardrails for public access, encryption, network exposure, tagging, and drift gates.

policies.name: Public S3 access is blocked
policies.description: Prevent public S3 ACLs in landing-zone accounts.

metadata.remediation: Use S3 Block Public Access and private bucket policies.
Enable default bucket encryption with SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS.

policies.name: Mandatory account tags
policies.description: Require ownership and environment tags for platform inventory.

metadata.remediation: Add owner, environment, and cost_center tags.

name: Azure Landing Zone Controls
description: Azure landing-zone controls for storage hardening, network exposure, identity, and compliance metadata.

policies.name: Azure storage public access is blocked
policies.description: Prevent public storage exposure in Azure landing zones.

metadata.remediation: Disable public blob access and enforce private endpoints for sensitive accounts.

policies.name: Azure storage encryption is required
policies.description: Require encrypted storage for landing-zone workloads.

metadata.remediation: Enable platform encryption and customer-managed keys where required.

name: Banking Resiliency Controls
description: Financial-services guardrails for encryption, exposure, tagging, and change evidence across cloud providers.

policies.name: Regulated data encryption is required
policies.description: Require encryption controls for regulated banking workloads.

metadata.remediation: Enable provider-native encryption and document key ownership.

policies.name: Internet exposure requires review
policies.description: Warn on broad ingress and public exposure patterns.

metadata.remediation: Restrict ingress to approved CIDR ranges or use private connectivity.

policies.name: Application ownership tags are mandatory
policies.description: Require ownership metadata for service accountability.

metadata.remediation: Add service_owner, business_unit, environment, and data_classification tags.
